description: Ireland's Health Service Executive (HSE) has approved weekly paclitaxel in combination with weekly trastuzumab (12 weeks) as available to patients within the public health system as a treatment option for the adjuvant treatment of patients with HER2 positive, node-negative breast cancer of tumor size <= 3cm. The European Medicines Agency product information for trastuzumab notes that trastuzumab should only be used in patients with metastatic or early breast cancer whose tumors have either HER2 overexpression or HER2 gene amplification as determined by an accurate and validated assay.
